      properties:
        type:

          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

        - message

## Summary

I implemented the optional, validated, lower-cased `email` field for owners. The flow is: `POST /api/owners` → `OwnerFieldsDto` → `Owner` entity → persisted → `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns it, so the field had to be threaded through the OpenAPI spec, the entity, the DB schema, and the controller.

Changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property to the `OwnerFields` schema. Since `Owner` is `allOf` `OwnerFields`, the code generator now produces `getEmail()`/`setEmail()` on both `OwnerFieldsDto` and `OwnerDto`, and MapStruct maps it automatically.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added an `email` column (nullable, since it's optional) with getter/setter.

3. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added a `normalizeEmail` helper: `null` (omitted) stays unset; a present value must match a syntactic email pattern (`^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`) or it throws `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` (→ 400); valid values are stored lower-cased via `toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)`. Wired into both `addOwner` and `updateOwner`.

4. **DB schemas** — Added an `email` column to the `owners` table in all four `schema.sql` files (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres).

5. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — The seed inserts used positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)`, which broke on the new column ("row column count mismatch"). I made them explicit about columns. (The h2/postgres seed files already used explicit column lists, so they needed no change.)

Verified behavior against the spec's three cases: mixed-case email stored/returned lower-cased, invalid email rejected with 400, and missing email accepted.

Note: this isn't a git repository, so I made no commits.
